name: The Ren'ai Horror Adventure: Hyouryuu Shoujo
original_name: THE 恋愛ホラーアドベンチャー 漂流少女
source:
On a summer night with a pleasant evening breeze, an abandoned school visited on a dare. It was supposed to be a fun memory, yet...

A boy and five girls find themselves trapped in that school, now sunken into the earth. An adventure where their survival is at stake begins, amidst darkness, silence, and sinister entities baring their fangs.

Choose your exploration partner from among the five girls and uncover the mysteries and cursed past hidden within the abandoned school in order to escape. Will you be able to return safely to your former life with "that girl"!?

Driven to desperation by hunger... the distribution of limited food holds the key to survival. They will come to know the true weight of the remaining provisions...

[Translated from [url=https://www.d3p.co.jp/s_20/s20_034.html]D3 Publisher[/url]]
